scope: independent read-only fixed-version container CONTENT validation; no new SQL, original claim, KMS, write credential, plaintext business proof or finalization authority

production.constructor: existing NewArtifactReadOnlyS3 with explicit original ArtifactReadLimits
production.native_reads: exact expected installation/backup/attempt/part container key; HEAD and one fixed-version full GET; no latest or range request
checks: actual whole-object SHA/size and actual HTTP EOF
same sequential bytes parsed and hashed; backward requests fail closed
each original ciphertext hash, stream envelope, checkpoint and scope via existing part-container Inspect
limits, context, absolute deadline and current pinned read credential rechecked before returning facts

test_scope.fixture: actual local AES-GCM C under cleared named local DATA key and actual part-container bytes; not a captured task or provider/SQL/business proof
test_scope.read_only: artifact write credential file removed before reader construction
reject_cases: cipher member corruption with updated whole hash
actual entered GET body deadline expiry
test_scope.adapter_model: known size does not synthesize EOF; backward read fails; separate real EOF probe required

limitations: No multi-GiB body was sent or read by these small-body tests.
No complete manifest/catalog/certificate trust chain is inferred from caller-supplied hashes.
No C plaintext authentication, six-domain business verification, staging cleanup, signed acceptance/catalog, final task CAS or restore proof is supplied.
Returned pc.Facts are inert values, not a private finalization receipt.
